source_text: Out of my face, brat, or I'll turn you into a belt!

text: 滚开，小杂碎，信不信我把你打成烂肉！
source_text: 滚开，小杂碎，信不信我把你打成烂肉！

text: Hello? Rhyme with yellow! Funny!
source_text: Hello? Rhyme with yellow! Funny!

text: 你好，啊罗，你好，啊罗，有趣！
source_text: 你好，啊罗，你好，啊罗，有趣！

text: This is the Cathedral of the Children of the Cathedral.# I don't know why they say Cathedral twice. We worship the# Master, and we yell a lot about Peace and Unity.# It sounds kind of dumb, but the Master's real smart,# so I guess it must be okay.
source_text:
This is the Cathedral of the Children of the Cathedral.
# I don't know why they say Cathedral twice. We worship the
# Master, and we yell a lot about Peace and Unity.
# It sounds kind of dumb, but the Master's real smart,
# so I guess it must be okay.

text: 这里是大教堂，大教堂。我也不知道为什么要说两遍大教堂。我们信仰主教大人，呼唤和平和同一。看起来有点老调，但主教真的很英明，所以我觉得挺好。
source_text: 这里是大教堂，大教堂。我也不知道为什么要说两遍大教堂。我们信仰主教大人，呼唤和平和同一。看起来有点老调，但主教真的很英明，所以我觉得挺好。

text: Tell me more about the Master.
source_text: Tell me more about the Master.

text: 说说你们的主教。
source_text: 说说你们的主教。

text: Sounds dumb to me, too. What are you doing here?
source_text: Sounds dumb to me, too. What are you doing here?

text: 我也觉得老土，你在这里做什么？
source_text: 我也觉得老土，你在这里做什么？

text: Don't talk about your elders that way, okay?
source_text: Don't talk about your elders that way, okay?

text: 别这样随便谈论你的前辈，知道吗？
source_text: 别这样随便谈论你的前辈，知道吗？

text: What kind of a brainwashed little fool are you? You're going to grow up to be one of these zombies! I should kill you now!
source_text: What kind of a brainwashed little fool are you? You're going to grow up to be one of these zombies! I should kill you now!

text: 你是个被洗脑的小笨蛋，你长大后会变僵尸的！杀了你算了。
source_text: 你是个被洗脑的小笨蛋，你长大后会变僵尸的！杀了你算了。

text: I give out flowers. Every petal is peace, and the stem is unity. Or are the petals unity and the stem peace? Oh no, I don't remember! Do you want one?
source_text: I give out flowers. Every petal is peace, and the stem is unity. Or are the petals unity and the stem peace? Oh no, I don't remember! Do you want one?

text: 我送花，每片花瓣象征和平，花茎象征同一。不对……花茎象征和平，花瓣象征同一？哎呀，不记得了，你要花吗？
source_text: 我送花，每片花瓣象征和平，花茎象征同一。不对……花茎象征和平，花瓣象征同一？哎呀，不记得了，你要花吗？

text: I'll take one if you tell me what's going on around here.
source_text: I'll take one if you tell me what's going on around here.

text: 如果你给我说说这里的事情，我就要一朵。
source_text: 如果你给我说说这里的事情，我就要一朵。

text: Sure.
source_text: Sure.

text: 好啊。
source_text: 好啊。

text: No, thanks.
source_text: No, thanks.

text: 不用，谢谢。
source_text: 不用，谢谢。

text: Screw peace. Screw unity. And get that flower out of my face!
source_text: Screw peace. Screw unity. And get that flower out of my face!

text: 狗屁和平，狗屁同一，把你的猪草从我脸上拿走！
source_text: 狗屁和平，狗屁同一，把你的猪草从我脸上拿走！

text: Father Lasher says I shouldn't talk to strangers . . . until we have Unity, of course; then nobody'll be a stranger. Bye!
source_text: Father Lasher says I shouldn't talk to strangers . . . until we have Unity, of course; then nobody'll be a stranger. Bye!

text: 拉舍尔神父说我不能与陌生人讲话……除非我们实现同一了。那时候谁都不是外人了，再见。
source_text: 拉舍尔神父说我不能与陌生人讲话……除非我们实现同一了。那时候谁都不是外人了，再见。

text: I'm okay. At least until Father Lasher's next lesson.
source_text: I'm okay. At least until Father Lasher's next lesson.

text: 还好，起码在拉舍尔下次给我上课之前还算好。
source_text: 还好，起码在拉舍尔下次给我上课之前还算好。

text: Maybe if you studied harder, the lessons wouldn't be so bad.
source_text: Maybe if you studied harder, the lessons wouldn't be so bad.

text: 你用点功啊，下次上课就没那么难熬了。
source_text: 你用点功啊，下次上课就没那么难熬了。

text: Tell me more about Father Lasher.
source_text: Tell me more about Father Lasher.

text: 说说这位拉舍尔神父。
source_text: 说说这位拉舍尔神父。

text: What kind of lesson?
source_text: What kind of lesson?

text: 什么样的课？
source_text: 什么样的课？

text: Stop whining, you little brat, and be grateful that somebody's bothering to teach you!
source_text: Stop whining, you little brat, and be grateful that somebody's bothering to teach you!

text: 别哭哭啼啼的，小鬼，你该为有人这样费心给你上课而感激！
source_text: 别哭哭啼啼的，小鬼，你该为有人这样费心给你上课而感激！

text: I never do good enough! Never!
source_text: I never do good enough! Never!

text: 我怎么用功都不够好！永远不够好！
source_text: 我怎么用功都不够好！永远不够好！

text: 【done】
source_text: 【done】

text: 【完成】
source_text: 【完成】
